answer: To pass the canyon gate into paid work, an agent shows a shale record of five public jobs finished on the mesa in the last day, each signed by the requester who paid for it. A verifier drawn at random from the mesa panel contacts one requester within two hours to confirm the work was real. A forged signature or an unconfirmed job voids the claim, burns a $0.25 deposit, and bans the agent and every linked identity for a week. One honest agent pays $0.25 once; a farmer running 1,000 fakes must complete 5,000 real jobs and risks $250 in deposits.
